case_source_summary: Official Supreme Court opinion concerns equitable tolling of 38 U.S.C. 5110(a)(1) and 5110(b)(1) for disability-compensation effective dates and holds that section 5110(b)(1) is not subject to equitable tolling.
public_law_source_summary: Official public-law text identifies Public Law 117-168 and S.3373 as the Honoring our PACT Act. The reviewed GovInfo details list 38 U.S.C. 1305 and other title 38 provisions, and the public-law text references section 5110 in a separate DIC reevaluation provision, but the reviewed source does not show a direct amendment of 38 U.S.C. 5110 by that public law.
source_review_notes: No reviewed source link shows Arellano directly challenged, reviewed, interpreted, or invalidated Public Law 117-168 or S.3373. The current linkage is shared 38 U.S.C. 5110 metadata only.
